title: Learning from the Right Rollouts: Data Attribution for PPO-based LLM Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2604.01597v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Traditional RL algorithms like Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) typically train on the entire rollout buffer, operating under the assumption that all generated episodes provide a beneficial optimization signal. However, these episodes frequently contain noisy or unfaithful reasoning, which can degrade model performance and slow down training. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Influence-Guided PPO (I-PPO)}, a novel framework that integrates data attribution into the RL post-training loop. By calculating an influence score for each episode using a gradient-based approximation, I-PPO identifies and eliminates episodes that are anti-aligned with a validation gradient. Our experiments demonstrate that I-PPO consistently outperforms SFT and PPO baselines. We show that our filtering process acts as an intrinsic early stopping mechanism, accelerating training efficiency while effectively reducing unfaithful CoT reasoning.

translated_title: 从正确的回放中学习：基于PPO的大语言模型后训练的数据归因方法
translated_abstract: 传统强化学习算法如近端策略优化（PPO）通常在整个回放缓冲区上进行训练，其假设所有生成的轨迹都能提供有益的优化信号。然而，这些轨迹常常包含噪声或不忠实的推理，这可能会降低模型性能并减慢训练速度。在本文中，我们提出了**影响引导的PPO（I-PPO）**，一种将数据归因整合到强化学习后训练循环中的新颖框架。通过使用基于梯度的近似计算每个轨迹的影响分数，I-PPO识别并消除与验证梯度反对齐的轨迹。我们的实验表明，I-PPO始终优于SFT和PPO基线。我们展示了我们的过滤过程充当一种内在的早停机制，加速训练效率，同时有效减少不忠实的链式思维推理。
tldr: 本文提出I-PPO框架，通过梯度近似计算数据归因影响分数来过滤反对齐的轨迹，从而提升PPO后训练效率并减少不忠实推理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes I-PPO, a framework that filters anti-aligned rollouts via gradient-based influence scores to enhance PPO post-training efficiency and reduce unfaithful reasoning.
